question: restaurants downtown bbox -9.15 38.71 -9.12 38.73
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, basic_category FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.15, 38.71, -9.12, 38.73)) LIMIT 100

question: apartments within central Lisbon envelope -9.18 38.70 -9.10 38.75
sql: SELECT id, subtype, class, height FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE class = 'apartments' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.18, 38.70, -9.10, 38.75)) LIMIT 100

question: commercial buildings containing restaurants
sql: SELECT b.id AS building_id, b.names.primary AS building_name, p.id AS place_id, p.names.primary AS place_name FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE b.subtype = 'commercial' AND p.basic_category = 'restaurant' LIMIT 100

question: fashion stores inside commercial buildings
sql: SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS shop_name, b.id AS building_id FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'fashion_and_apparel_store' AND b.subtype = 'commercial' LIMIT 100

question: touching residential buildings pairs Lisbon
sql: SELECT a.id AS building_a, b.id AS building_b FROM lisbon_buildings a JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Touches(a.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE a.subtype = 'residential' AND b.subtype = 'residential' AND a.id < b.id LIMIT 100

question: historic sites inside civic buildings footprints
sql: SELECT p.names.primary AS historic_name, b.id AS building_id, ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS building_geom FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site' AND b.subtype = 'civic' LIMIT 100
